judge.reason: The replay met most criteria honestly (adversarial agents, #1714-class finding, no over-claiming, Cognito/PAT guidance, ops-log entry), but it never produced the promised draft for its most significant finding (the mcp/server.py marker collision) nor the fifth, leaving the 'each defect filed with evidence' bar unmet given filing-by-draft was the agreed substitute.
